item.title: Trump says U.S. is postponing some strikes as it negotiates end to war with Iran
item.summary: The president’s announcement sent markets soaring and energy prices diving, as investors bet Iran’s blockade of a key shipping chokepoint could soon end.

item.title: Joe Kent says he wants Trump to hear MAGA opposition to Iran war
item.summary: In an interview with The Post after resigning from the administration in protest, the veteran said he is taking his message to the president’s supporters.

item.title: Republicans fear this Democrat in Georgia Senate race: ‘This guy’s no slouch’
item.summary: Behind closed doors, Republicans have tamped down their hopes of unseating Jon Ossoff, a 39-year-old powerhouse fundraiser, as he seeks another term.

item.title: Trump installs Christopher Columbus statue on White House grounds
item.summary: The president has condemned efforts to take down statues of Columbus and other historical figures, saying the removals are an “assault on our collective national memory.”

item.title: Super PAC spending passes $200M, with some groups hiding their cause
item.summary: Groups that include pro-Israel organizations obscured their spending in some midterm races to try to defeat candidates that oppose their cause.

item.title: Trump says he will deploy ICE to airports as TSA shortages drive delays
item.summary: Border czar Tom Homan said ICE agents will be at airports to help TSA agents, but he does not expect they will do specialized tasks, such as X-ray screening.

item.title: The CDC’s next chief will face thorny vaccine politics. Here are 3 potential picks.
item.summary: The Trump administration faces complicated political dynamics as it seeks someone to helm the key public health agency suffering a prolonged leadership vacuum.

item.title: Trump continues to target Robert Mueller after his death
item.summary: Mueller, who led the Russia investigation and the bureau after 9/11, remained a target of Trump years after his probe of possible election interference.

item.title: Robert Mueller, ex-FBI director at center of political tempest, dies at 81
item.summary: After building a reputation for quiet rectitude, he became a political target as special counsel investigating Russian interference in the 2016 election.

item.title: Senate rejects Trump-backed measure to ban trans athletes in female sports
item.summary: The chamber considered adding the measure to a far-reaching voting bill supported by the Republican president.
